wealth_origin.summary: Sheikh Tahnoon's financial base comes from inherited membership of Abu Dhabi's Al Nahyan ruling family, whose natural-resource wealth arose from oil. He has expanded a separate family and private-business sphere through Royal Group, the 61% shareholder of IHC and part of his business empire. By contrast, ADIA and ADQ are sovereign institutions funded or owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi; his chairmanship gives stewardship, not personal ownership, of those assets.

confidence.reason: Established reporting supports the oil-derived family origin and Royal Group/IHC expansion, while ADIA and ADQ directly document their government relationship; the precise beneficial ownership and division of wealth within the ruling family remain private.

biography.plain_text: Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan is an Emirati royal, investor and national-security official whose financial base lies in Abu Dhabi's oil-derived ruling-family wealth. He expanded that position through Royal Group, a family office that controls a majority of listed conglomerate IHC, while separately chairing the government-owned sovereign investors ADIA and ADQ. He also serves as Abu Dhabi's Deputy Ruler and UAE National Security Adviser, and chairs the artificial-intelligence group G42.
